_source: Captured from nargo 1.0.0-beta.26 (noirc 40d6574f) by executing a Noir program that prints each hash. These are ground truth: any Rust implementation intended to feed a Noir circuit must reproduce them exactly, or the root the verifier rebuilds will differ from the one the circuit computes and every proof will fail.
_noir_stdlib_note: In this version std::hash exposes poseidon2_permutation and pedersen_hash. Poseidon v1 and sha256 are NOT in the stdlib; they moved to external libraries.
